title: 第12章 不喜欢女生，王冬儿的危机感
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“行吧，那你呢？”周漪最后看向王冬儿。

虽然她很不想跟王冬儿说话，但三个人都选控制系，她实在没办法理解。

“你的武魂明明白白是强攻型的，为何也要写控制系？”

“老师，你不知道呀。难道直接把对方打死了，不能算控制吗？”

“你……”周漪被王冬儿的话直接噎住。

“哼，我懒得管你们，你们爱选什么就选什么吧，都给我滚！”

三人赶紧溜出教室。

他们肚子早就饿了，直接跑向食堂。

对于王冬儿，周漪的心情是复杂的。王冬儿无论是天赋还是实力，都是班上最强的，可他偏偏老喜欢跟自己作对。

想要开除吧，又开除不掉，实在是烦人。

吃完饭后，萧萧想跟他们一起去练习，王冬儿拒绝了。

“你看了我们这么多次战斗，难道对我们的魂技还不熟悉吗？而且之前和你战斗的那一次，我们也知道你的魂技了，不用练习也能吊打其他队伍。”

之前王冬儿和霍雨浩战斗的时候，萧萧有些手痒便加入了，变成了三人混战。

“那行吧，等到比赛的时候，我让你们见识一下我双生武魂的厉害。”

萧萧离开之后，霍雨浩忽然在王冬儿旁边说道。

“王冬，我怎么觉得萧萧好像是喜欢你？”

“你为什么会这么觉得？”

“因为我发现她总爱盯着你看，你长得这么好看，应该会有很多女孩子喜欢。”

霍雨浩觉得自己如果是女孩子的话，也会喜欢王冬儿的。

“笨蛋，萧萧看你的眼神不也是一样的吗？再说了，我不喜欢女生。”

“？？？”霍雨浩一脸问号。

王冬儿转身就走，霍雨浩赶紧追上来。

“你刚刚说的不喜欢女生到底是什么意思啊？”

王冬儿没有回答，脸上满是笑容，只留下霍雨浩苦恼不已。

下午放学后，霍雨浩还是来到学院门口卖烤鱼。

王冬儿也一次不落地来帮忙。

学院周围的人基本上都认识他们两个了。

“霍雨浩，给我来条烤鱼。”徐三石弹过来一枚银魂币。

王冬儿伸手接住。

“哟，怎么了，徐大少爷这几天没钱了呀？金魂币改成银魂币了。”

“切，我是钱多，但我又不是傻子，一条银魂币都够买两条了。”

“好的，徐学长，我给你挑一只大的。”

徐三石尝过霍雨浩的烤鱼后，也被这美味吸引了，基本上每天都会来买一条。

"Okay, what about you?" Zhou Yi finally looked at Wang Donger.

Although she really didn't want to talk to Wang Dong'er, she really couldn't understand that all three of them chose the control system.

"Your martial spirit is clearly an offensive type, why do you also write it as a control type?"

"Teacher, you don't know. Doesn't it count as control if you just beat the other person to death?"

"You..." Zhou Yi choked directly on Wang Dong'er's words.

"Hmph, I don't care about you. You can choose whatever you want, and get out of here!"

The three of them quickly slipped out of the classroom.

They were already hungry and ran directly to the cafeteria.

Regarding Wang Donger, Zhou Yi had complicated feelings.Wang Donger is the strongest in the class in terms of both talent and strength, but he always likes to go against himself.

I want to be fired, but I can't be fired. It's really annoying.

After eating, Xiao Xiao wanted to practice with them, but Wang Donger refused.

"You have watched us fight so many times, are you still not familiar with our soul skills? And from the previous battle with you, we also knew your soul skills, and you can defeat other teams without practicing."

When Wang Donger and Huo Yuhao were fighting before, Xiao Xiao felt itchy and joined in. It turned into a three-person melee.

"Okay, wait until the competition, I will let you see the power of my twin martial arts."

After Xiao Xiao left, Huo Yuhao suddenly said next to Wang Donger.

"Wang Dong, why do I feel like Xiao Xiao likes you?"

"Why do you think so?"

"Because I found that she always likes to stare at you. You are so good-looking, so many girls should like you."

Huo Yuhao felt that if he were a girl, he would also like Wang Donger.

"Idiot, doesn't Xiao Xiao look at you the same way? Besides, I don't like girls."

"???" Huo Yuhao had a question mark on his face.

Wang Donger turned around and left, and Huo Yuhao quickly caught up with him.

"What did you mean when you just said you don't like girls?"

Wang Donger did not answer, with a smile on her face, leaving Huo Yuhao troubled.

After school in the afternoon, Huo Yuhao came to the entrance of the college to sell grilled fish.

Wang Donger never even came down to help.

Basically everyone around the academy knows them both.

"Huo Yuhao, bring me a grilled fish." Xu Sanshi flicked a silver soul coin over.

Wang Donger reached out to catch it.

"Hey, what's wrong? Master Xu has no money these days? The gold soul coins have been changed to silver soul coins."

"Tch, I have a lot of money, but I'm not a fool. One Gintama coin is enough to buy two."

"Okay, Senior Xu, I'll pick a big one for you."

After Xu Sanshi tasted Huo Yuhao's grilled fish, he was also attracted by the delicious food and would buy one basically every day.
